operators.name: lp_pool2d_forward
semantics: Computes Lp pooling with p = norm_type over each pooling window of size kernel_size x kernel_size
Stride defaults to kernel_size if None; here stride=2
ceil_mode=False means floor((H - kernel_size)/stride) + 1 for output height, same for width; with H=512, kernel_size=3, stride=2 -> outH=255, outW=255
For each output position, gather elements in the window, compute p-norm: (sum |x_i|^p)^(1/p)
Here norm_type=2, so it's Euclidean norm of each 3x3 window

Input must be contiguous or handled accordingly; in this task input is contiguous from torch.randn, but contract says layout supports strides, so implementation should handle strides or make contiguous internally
No bias, no padding, dilation=1, no groups

reference_steps.source: return F.lp_pool2d(x, norm_type=self.norm_type, kernel_size=self.kernel_size, stride=self.stride, ceil_mode=self.ceil_mode)
semantics: Exactly the Lp pooling operation implemented by the custom op lp_pool2d_forward with norm_type=2, kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=False
Returns a tensor of shape [128, 3, 255, 255] on CUDA
